a7sii_10.description: Sony a7S II, 19 frames 4240x2832 JPEG, static tripod, clear sky. The pilot's sequence.

gui_splash_video.description: The gui's splash video (11_30_2024-fx3-aurora-topaz-star.mp4). A build input of Star.app, not test data.

a7sii_10_tiff16.description: The a7sii_10 frames as 19 LZW-compressed 16-bit TIFFs (4240x2832), converted from the JPEGs with ImageMagick. The content has only 8-bit precision: it tests the 16-bit TIFF format path.

a7sii_10_sky_tiff16.description: The a7sii_10 frames cropped to the sky (full width, top 1800 rows, no ground in any frame; the horizon peaks near row 2020), 16-bit LZW TIFF.

a7sii_10_h264.description: a7sii_10.mp4: the 19 a7sii_10 JPEGs as 4240x2832 H.264 (libx264, crf 12, yuv420p, 30 fps), 19 frames per ffprobe.

moving_a7iv_1_aurora_tiff16.description: 19 frames (LRT_00085-LRT_00103) of the a7 IV aurora pan, camera moving with the horizon in frame: 4240x2827 16-bit LZW TIFF, downscaled from 7008x4672.
